title: Animal Style Rosti
summary: Crisp Swiss potato pancake topped with caramelized onions and In-N-Out style spread.
difficulty_reason: Caramelizing onions and flipping a large potato pancake takes timing and care.

ingredients.line: 1 1/2 lb russet potatoes, peeled and shredded into thin strands
3 tbsp butter or neutral oil, for frying

steps: Slowly cook the sliced onions in oil over medium-low heat, stirring often, for 30 to 40 minutes until deep golden and jammy.
Whisk the mayonnaise, ketchup, relish, white vinegar and sugar into a spread, and refrigerate until needed.
Shred the potatoes into thin strands, squeeze out as much moisture as you can, and toss with the salt.
Heat the butter or oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and pack in the potatoes in an even layer, pressing flat.
Cook for 12 to 15 minutes until the bottom is deep golden and crisp, then flip and cook another 10 minutes.
Rest the rosti on a rack so the crust stays crisp.
Spread the sauce over the rosti, pile on the caramelized onions and scatter with chives.
Serve right away with a fork and knife.
tips: Squeeze the shredded potato dry for the crispiest crust.
Rest the rosti on a wire rack, not a plate, so steam doesn't soften it.
